official_definition: Solo Stage - If Soul Core is on this Spirit, "[NAME]"-named cards you control can't be destroyed or returned to Hand/Deck from Field by opposing effects.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Solo Stage] or [Solo Stage: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Solo Stage]", "give [Solo Stage]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
